sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def state(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in('R','b','N') and n['pixels']==16 and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])<50:
            d[n['color']]=[min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']>=36:
            d['player']=[min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])]
    beamrows=set()
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in('w','g') and n['pixels']>=2:
            r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']); r1=max(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
            if r0<50 and (r1-r0)<=1: beamrows.add(r0)
    d['beamrows']=sorted(beamrows)
    return d
print("before:",state(current_frame))
action(['UP'])
print("after 1UP:",state(current_frame))
action(['UP'])
print("after 2UP:",state(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
